KitchenGrid Privacy Policy, effective March 20, 2011
We collect staff names, shift preferences and work email addresses from our
customers.
We use them only to build and send schedules. We do not sell them.
We delete a closed customer's data 90 days after the account closes.
Questions go to privacy@harborlabs.example.
